notes: A227345.A227345_conjecture: for n > 0, 0 < T n k <-> 0 < k /\ 3 k^2 <= 4 n, with T n k = #{S subset {1..n} : sum S = n, bdry S = k}, bdry S = #{p in S : not (p-1 in S and p+1 in S)}; A227345_conjecture_real gives the entry's real wording. Key idea: boundary parts contain no three consecutive integers, so 4*sum >= 3k^2 (induction on the largest element); pairs {3j+1,3j+2} plus a top pair or singleton realise every n >= 3k^2/4. Also proves A227568 a(n) = floor(2 sqrt(n/3)). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: none (agreement of T with the b-file checked by certificate/check.py only).
